sourceCollage.screenshotMatch: The user-supplied collage visibly matches the media displayed in the captured source post; it is retained as a higher-resolution private layout input, not as proof of a reuse licence.

pixelPolicy: Every visible account identity, avatar, verification badge, source sentence and reply sentence is an exact crop of the retained live-thread capture. The media panel uses the exact user-supplied collage. No identity, interface wording, face or product image was regenerated.
motionPolicy: Static source, static reply and static media. No motion is invented because the source asset is not motion-native.

watermarkPolicy.placement: The short marks sit on the editorial composite to survive simple cropping while the source account identity remains fully visible.
watermarkPolicy.ownershipBoundary: The watermark identifies JeloCare's edit; it is not a licence, ownership claim or authority to reuse the source account's identity, wording or collage.

imageGeneration.reason: Exact screenshot crop-and-compose preserves the live exchange and avoids fabricated identity, body, product or interface pixels.

publicationBoundary: The Zapshot remains ignored, local, private and unpublished. Cross-platform publication requires compatible third-party rights and fresh action-time confirmation.
